SBP: When possible, clearly addressed how recurrences will be prevented*
Provided contact information for follow-up questions
ICS: Verbalized an empathetic statement during discussion of events
Made appropriate eye contact and maintained focus during interaction
Exhibited positive, open body language in interaction with patient/family
Did not interrupt patient/family during interaction
Inquired about patient/family’s current emotions regarding the event
Used patient’s words/phrasing during summation of conversation
Clearly stated why the error occurred
Discussed the results/implications of the error
PROF: Explicitly stated that an error occurred
Used the phrase “I am sorry” during disclosure
Accepted responsibility on behalf of physician/hospital*
